title: Alice's Night at the Mansion
description:
Free Alice’s beloved dog, Dinah, from the mischievous ghosts of Monster Mansion in a hand-drawn, point-and-click-inspired mystery with choice-based gameplay and multiple endings!

Witches, werewolves, and vampires are just some of the guests at Monster Mansion, and it’s up to Alice to get them out of their rooms and into the party.

Meet the five guests, including a kind Witch, a gentlemanly Werewolf, and an eccentric Mummy. Talk with them, and they might regale you with stories about past lovers, garlic revenge, and... barbecued rabbits?

Alice must use every resource at her disposal to find lost items, help ghosts and monsters alike, and discover secrets, all while avoiding the pesky Pete and his obsessive thievery.

Explore the mansion, find clues, and use the items you collect to help Alice free her dog, Dinah.

Locked rooms and cranky vampires are just a few of the obstacles Alice has to face in this adventure.

Will Alice uncover all of the mansion's secrets?

Is this going to be the best party ever?

Or will Alice end up trapped in a cage alongside Dinah?!

The answer is up to you as your choices bring you to one of many possible outcomes!

Features:• A dialogue-rich, comedy adventure inspired by point-and-click games

• Classic 4:3 visuals with frame-by-frame animation and hand-drawn assets

• Choice-based gameplay with multiple endings

• Story-rich: interact with characters and read books

*No AI was used in the creation of this game.
description_short: Three eccentric ghosts have kidnapped Alice's dog, Dinah! Help Alice free her dog, solve the mysteries of Monster Mansion, and make the annual Monster Party a success in this hand-drawn, point-and-click-inspired comedy adventure!
